purpose: Treatment-research data feasibility; local status is not evidence of efficacy or permission for unrelated restricted data

resources.name: MSK NSCLC checkpoint-immunotherapy public clinical cohort
resources.record_grain: 240 patients and 240 molecular samples; one-to-one in this pinned study
resources.units: Original mutation rate per Mb; DCB YES/NO/NE; source PFS months/status
resources.access: Official public cBioPortal Datahub ODbL 1.0 snapshot; source license retained. No restricted or identifying records acquired.
resources.limitations: Selected MSK treated cohort, not Iowa. 36 post-treatment specimens reported in paper cannot be filtered from public fields. No randomized treatment comparator. Two TMB field vintages differ. NE excluded explicitly. Keep related MSK cohorts and repeated patients from leaking across validation.

resources.name: DepMap Public 26Q3 current release documentation
resources.record_grain: Model/condition/screen/profile and gene-level matrices; current manifest access incomplete
resources.units: Chronos effects, dependency probabilities, omics units depend on file
resources.access: Official release announcement verified; current downloads and terms returned human verification. Current matrix inventory/license not assumed from older release.
resources.limitations: 26Q3 changes library effects and removes 96 library-restricted genes from specified files. Do not merge old/current releases as independent experiments or assume older license/schema.

resources.name: DepMap Public 24Q4 v1 reproducible archive
resources.record_grain: Model, condition, screen and profile metadata; source response/omics matrices separately listed
resources.units: Chronos gene effects, dependency probability, log2 TPM+1, source mutation categories
resources.access: Public version-pinned Figshare archive; CC BY 4.0 verified for this release.
resources.limitations: Basal cell-model screens do not identify treated residual states or normal-tissue safety. Related models/shared source patients require grouped validation. Processing predates 26Q3 corrections.

resources.name: PRISM Repurposing Public 24Q2 v1 extended primary screen
resources.record_grain: Treatment by model; lower-level screen/culture/pool/dose and technical replicates
resources.units: Log2 barcode viability versus DMSO; new screens five days at 2.5 micromolar
resources.limitations: Metadata overlap is not compound-specific evaluability. Negative viability LFC is not automatically cell death. Single-dose response is not an IC50 or combination synergy. Documentation new-compound counts differ (1514/1522).

resources.name: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 v4 dose-response screen
resources.record_grain: Compound batch by model by screen; fitted dose-response parameters
resources.units: Source auc, ec50, ic50, convergence and r2; eight fourfold dilutions starting at 10 micromolar
resources.limitations: Older separate screen; not dose-response for every 24Q2 compound. Technical redo MTS010 is not independent biological validation. Endpoint and dose interval differ from GDSC and single-dose PRISM.

resources.name: GDSC2 release 8.5 fitted dose-response workbook
resources.record_grain: Model by compound by fitted curve with concentration range and QC
resources.units: LN_IC50 is natural log micromolar; normalized AUC depends on tested dose interval
resources.access: Official 21,330,376-byte workbook URL HEAD 200; old CancerRxGene portal 410. Follow Sanger use terms; latest complete inventory unverified.
resources.limitations: Same/related cell models can overlap Broad and GDSC1/GDSC2; different assays are not necessarily independent biological validation. Preserve 72-hour ATP assay, dose bounds and RMSE; cancer model response is not patient efficacy.

resources.name: Sanger Cell Model Passports model metadata snapshot
resources.record_grain: 1984 model rows in mutable latest model-list snapshot
resources.units: Categorical model/provenance metadata, not response measurements
resources.access: Sanger custom terms, not assumed CC BY. Source manifest preserves actual download URL and hash.
resources.limitations: Aliases and shared source-patient/derived models require review. Literal identifier match does not prove independent biology or matching treated condition.

resources.name: Maynard targeted-therapy lung adenocarcinoma single-cell study
resources.record_grain: Biopsy/sample within patient, then cells; source paper 49 biopsies from 30 patients across drivers/therapies
resources.units: Raw integer RNA counts and natural-log1p counts-per-10000 expression in the audited processed malignant-cell object; exact17-gene signature and scoring rule verified.
resources.access: Public author repository pinned at de138c79bcfc2fa3a28c8a039a28ab560da78099; source metadata, code pointers and the author-linked568368135-byte NI04 malignant Seurat object acquired and hash-audited. Local reanalysis only; raw source object/code redistribution not cleared. Independent GSE292469 cohort is separately documented as TD-DATA-09.
resources.limitations: Discovery cohort, not independent validation. Main common-EGFR/osimertinib candidate pairs shrink from 3 metadata pairs to 2 with any malignant cells and 1 with at least 10 each. Source metadata require cell-ID realignment to expression; source object checks pass. Exact historical Seurat patch remains unpinned. Raw author object/code not mirrored publicly.

resources.name: GSE292469 independent EGFR-mutant lung cancer single-nucleus cohort, November 2026 release
resources.record_grain: 457,724 QC nuclei in 74 core libraries from 73 unmatched patients/specimens; MRD2 has two cores
resources.units: Raw integer UMI counts; deposited tumor flag and source treatment-state/clinical annotations
join_keys: gene symbol and source feature ID (both symbols in this H5)
resources.access: Public on 2026-11-01. GEO/NCBI provider permits open reanalysis subject to third-party rights; no record-specific use condition found. Raw originals remain local; publish original aggregate analysis/code with attribution. No controlled data acquired.
resources.limitations: Non-Iowa, unmatched patients; source histology includes transformed SCLC. LUAD and at least 20 tumor cells leaves 26 TN/9 MRD/24 PD. Major stage/site/procedure/kit imbalance; Series/GSM kit contradiction. Raw UMI differs from author SoupX assay. Descriptive state comparison cannot isolate treatment-induced change or establish target efficacy.
